The '''sand slum pirates''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] active on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==History==
{{Quote|Little skeptical, eh? I guess I don't blame you. After all, we are pirates! Har, Har! Oh--the task, right. Some of our boys were looting a rancher's house when he walked in. He and his wife are holding our boys captive. We want you to go and help them escape.|The Pirate Leader, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the pirates harassed a couple of farmers, [[Roric Goldenfield|Roric]] and [[Helen Goldenfield]], who inhabited a [[The Ranch|ranch]] near their [[Pirate Base|base]].<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Roric Goldenfield managed to capture two of them, [[Arian Vh'ra]] and [[Itr Fairla]], while they were looting the ranch and hold them captive in the house. In the meantime, an [[Hero of Tatooine|adventurer]] attacked the pirates in their base. Nevertheless, the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] spared the pirate leader's life after he surrendered. The pirate leader tasked the spacer to head to the ranch and free the captive pirates. However, the spacer instead [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|helped]] Helen Goldenfield to prevent the pirates to escape while her husband was contacting [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sand slum pirates appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The sand slum pirates and their base were added to the game as part of the revamped version of the [[W:c:swg:Hero of Tatooine|"Hero of Tatooine" questline]],<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

Players taking part in the "Honor" portion of the "Hero of Tatooine" had to fight the sand slum pirates in their base and defeat their leader.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> This version of the quest was significantly easier than the original in which players had to find and defeat a generic "pirate leader" who spawned at random location across Tatooine.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> However, upon release of the "Publish 25", several bugs affected the new pirate leader and it was impossible to compete the quest until the publication of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2.7|Chapter 2.7]]" update, on [[September 6]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
